definitions.explanation: Lacquerware made in Wajima, on the Noto Peninsula in Ishikawa Prefecture. Known for its durability, from many coats of lacquer mixed with a local powdered earth, and for gold decoration. A designated traditional craft of Japan.

examples.japanese: {輪島塗|わじまぬり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{椀|わん}→お椀：06507_owan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a Wajima lacquer bowl.

examples.japanese: {輪島塗|わじまぬり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧で⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧: lacquerware in general

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Noto Peninsula earthquake of January 1, 2024 heavily damaged Wajima and many of its lacquer workshops; rebuilding the craft has been followed closely in Japanese news.
